jobs.title: Back-End Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description:
**Description**

  

### **About Xe**

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

### **About This Role**

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
* Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
* Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
* Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* 6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
* Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
* Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
* Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
* Strong written and verbal communication.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
* Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
* Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive Salary & Discretionary Bonus
* 23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days)
* Paid day off for your Birthday
* 4% employer pension contribution
* Discounted Euronet ESPP
* Life Cover, Income Protection & Critical Illness cover
* Healthcare
* Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
* Volunteering day for a charity of your choice

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.

Xe is an **Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

The position responsibilities outlined above are intended to define the general contents and requirements to perform this job. It is not to be taken as a complete statement of responsibilities or requirements. This job description does not restrict the Company's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job as needed.

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and pragmatic Senior Java Developer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of robust software solutions that drive our business forward. Your expertise in Java and related technologies will be instrumental in creating scalable, high-performance applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative features, optimize existing systems, and ensure the highest standards of quality and security. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about building impactful software, this opportunity is perfect for you!

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the full software development lifecycle for Java-based applications, including planning, coding, testing, and deployment
* Design and develop RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless integration with front-end systems and third-party services
* Collaborate with front-end developers using Angular, React, or other UI frameworks to create engaging user interfaces with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and UI best practices
* Develop and maintain microservices architectures utilizing technologies such as Spring Boot, Hibernate, and WCF for efficient service communication
* Optimize database interactions through effective database design using MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or MongoDB
* Write clean, efficient code with a focus on unit testing and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables
* Participate actively in Agile methodologies like Scrum to promote continuous improvement and timely project delivery

**Requirements**

* Proven experience as a Java Developer with a strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
* Extensive knowledge of Java frameworks such as Spring (including Spring MVC),.NET technologies (.NET Core), and ASP.NET Core
* Hands-on experience with front-end development using Angular or React along with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Bootstrap for responsive UI design
* Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure for deploying scalable applications
* Proficiency in working with RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, XML, JSON data formats, and API integration techniques
* Strong understanding of database management systems including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server (T-SQL), Oracle PL/SQL or MongoDB for data modeling and database design
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN to manage code repositories effectively
* Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), UML diagrams for system modeling, and Agile methodologies like Scrum
* Ability to troubleshoot issues through debugging tools in Eclipse or Visual Studio and perform performance tuning where necessary
* Familiarity with Linux environments and scripting languages such as Bash or Shell Scripting for deployment automation

Join us to be part of an innovative team that values your expertise! We offer an environment where your skills will make a real impact on our products while supporting your professional growth through continuous learning opportunities. If you’re passionate about developing cutting-edge software solutions using Java and modern technologies—apply now to elevate your career!

Pay: £60,000.00-£80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Free fitness classes

Ability to commute/relocate:

* London, Greater London: reliably commute or be willing to relocate with an employer-provided relocation package (preferred)

Education:

* Master's (required)

Experience:

* Project leadership: 3 years (preferred)

Licence/Certification:

* Driving Licence (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Developer Placement
jobs.description:
**The role**

Technology drives what we do at NEXT, and as a Tech Placement, you will be a vital part of our evolution. This role is designed to help you learn and grow by giving you hands-on experience in full life-cycle development.

You will make a real difference by contributing to team objectives and helping to create and enhance new and existing systems. Working alongside and shadowing a supportive team of experienced Developers, Product Development Managers, Business Analysts, and Architects, you will receive the guidance you need to succeed.

**This is a 12-month industrial placement and applicants must be studying a relevant University Degree course that includes a dedicated placement year July 2027 to July 2028.**

**What you'll take on**

* Shadow our experienced Developers to learn about and participate in full life-cycle development.
  
* Help create and enhance applications using a wide variety of backend and front-end technologies, including C#, .NET, VUE.JS, HTML, and CSS.
  
* Write readable and maintainable code that fulfils user requirements to agreed quality standards.
  
* Collaborate closely within your team to troubleshoot, identify, and resolve bugs in the codebase.
  
* Implement, test, and deploy code changes following the company's development process.
  
* Participate actively in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews to discuss challenges and share your progress.
  
* Adapt to and utilise new AI technologies, such as CoPilot, Gemini, and Notebook LM, to streamline your ways of working and increase efficiencies.
  

**What you'll bring**

* Current study towards a STEM degree (on track for a 2:1 or higher) or a STEM Master's degree that includes a 12-month placement, ideally with relevant studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field.
  
* We are looking for someone with a strong interest in how software works and a self-motivated desire to learn.
  
* You will bring a basic understanding of core languages like C#, VB.NET, VUE.JS, HTML, CSS, and Javascript, alongside the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies.
  
* Beyond your technical potential, you will need to be a great communicator who listens well, thinks in a structured manner, and collaborates effortlessly with others.
  

BE BRAVE. BE YOU. BE NEXT.

  

* 25% off most NEXT, MADE\*, Lipsy\*, Gap\* and Victoria's Secret\* products (\*when purchased through NEXT)
* Company performance based bonus
* Sharesave scheme
* On-site Nursery available; OFSTED outstanding in all areas
* 10% off most partner brands & up to 15% off Branded Beauty
* Early VIP access to sale stock
* Access to fantastic discounts at our Staff Shops
* Restaurants with great food at amazing prices
* Access a digital GP and other free health and wellbeing services
* Free on-site parking
* Financial Wellbeing - Save, track and enhance your financial wellbeing
* Apprenticeship - Grow and develop on the job whilst gaining a qualification
* Direct to Work - Discount online and instore, collect your items the next day for free from your place of work or local store
* Support Networks - Access to Network Groups to empower and celebrate each other
Wellhub - Discounted flexible monthly gym memberships, with apps, PT sessions and more

  

Conditions apply to all benefits. These benefits are discretionary and subject to change.

  

We aim to support all candidates during the application process and are happy to provide workplace adjustments when necessary. Should you need support with your application due to a disability or long-term condition, feel free to get in touch with us by email headoffice\_careers@next.co.uk (please include 'Workplace Adjustments' in the subject line), or call us on 0116 284 2486 and leave a voicemail.

  
You know Next, but did you know we’re a FTSE-100 retail company employing over 44,000 people across the Next group. We’re the UK’s 2nd largest fashion retailer and for Kidswear we’re the market leader. At the last count we have over 450 stores, plus the Next Online and it’s now possible to buy on-line from over 80 countries around the world! So we’ve gone global!
